item.title: Tree needs to be cut down, 30th October
item.description:
Urgent safety inspection and remedial work required for the street tree located directly outside 115 Crofton Lane (BR5 1HB). The tree is showing severe signs of structural vulnerability and decay, posing an immediate risk to the public footpath, parked vehicles, and surrounding properties: Recent Storm Damage: During recent high winds (Storm Boelo), a large branch snapped and fell directly onto the garden fence shared between my property and my neighbour's, causing structural damage. Major Rot & Open Wounds: There is a significant, exposed broken limb junction on the main trunk that is hollowed out, dark, and rotting internally. Fungal Growth: Large bracket fungi (fungal fruiting bodies) are visibly growing directly out of the main trunk, indicating advanced internal wood decay and a compromised root/trunk system. Deadwood & Cracks: There are large vertical deadwood sections, deep bark splits, and a previous major cut that is failing. Given its location right next to the public footpath and road, this tree is highly unstable and an urgent hazard. Please send an arboricultural officer to inspect and make safe as soon as possible.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 2a, Broadcroft Road, Poverest, Orpington, Greater London
